before.overview: While attempting to reply to the first reply in the target post on AskReddit with 'don't panic', the agent realizes it is on the forums index page instead of the post. To recover, the agent navigates back to the previously visited page, expecting to return to the post view where the target reply is located.
before.state_transition: The transition moves from the 'List of forums' page (http://localhost:9080/forums) to the Postmill home page (http://localhost:900/). The 'List of forums' content, including the list of forum categories like 'AskReddit' and 'relationship_advice', disappears and is replaced by the home page layout featuring 'Submissions', 'Comments', and 'Featured forums' sections. This indicates a successful navigation back to the site root, though the specific post remains inaccessible.

before.overview: Continuing the recovery effort after being redirected to the home page, the agent realizes the back navigation took it too far from the goal. The agent uses the forward navigation button to return to the forums index, aiming to re-enter the flow of locating the AskReddit post and its first reply.
before.state_transition: The transition moves from the Postmill home page (http://localhost:900/) back to the 'List of forums' page (http://localhost:9080/forums). The home page elements such as 'Submissions', 'Comments', and the message 'You are not subscribed to any forum' are replaced by the forum index content, which includes the navigation bar with 'Forums', 'Tags', and 'Alphabetical' links, followed by the list of forum categories like 'AskReddit', 'relationship_advice', and others. The page state is effectively restored to the view before the back navigation occurred.
